inlines.v: NEOPHYTE, noun 1. A new convert or proselyte; a name given by the early Christians to such heathens as had recently embraced the Christian faith, and were considered as regenerated by baptism. 2. A novice; one newly admitted to the order of priest. 3. A tyro; a beginner in learning.
